kubectl describe pod -n dojo-docker-platform -l app=api — look at the Events section for the actual error
docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64 produces an amd64 image regardless of your host CPU architecture

After building: kind load docker-image dojo/api:amd64-fixed --name dojo, then kubectl set image deployment/api api=dojo/api:amd64-fixed -n dojo-docker-platform, then annotate with dojo.docker/fixed-platform=linux/amd64
